# Architecture Gate selection

Epic Planner records an Architecture Gate when an initiative materially changes a subsystem,
shared/public contract, persistent data or migration, security/trust boundary, reliability,
concurrency, transactions, synchronization/eventing, deployment topology, shared component,
modernization path, or major performance/scalability constraint.

Use the contract defined by `engineering/the-architect/references/architecture-gate.md`. Do not
require it for Retouch Mode or ordinary localized work. Planner selects and records the gate; it
does not perform Architecture Preflight itself.
